book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Bita bɛ Joŋ tanyɛ jwe
Gɛ̀ no Bita bɛ Joŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ bo jɛme bamii le noo, bachiji kintanyɛ bamu bɛ bikwɛɛ bi bamii ba nchi bo gɛ̀ chiɛɛne yeh yi kintanyɛ mo Basadushii bamu selɛ fo.
Bo gɛ̀ toonyi shɛ́ŋ nje Bita bɛ Joŋ gɛ̀ yɛyi bamii, bo feeji lɛ no Jiso gɛ̀ bu yi kwe le, le no baŋkfu lé bo gê bo bû tɛ yi kwe le.
Bo mo bo koo bo ba gɛɛŋ ba faa no gɛ̀ bee wa fɛnfu, lɛ bvu doo bvuyuu, fɛ bo tû bo yûge.
Geenɛ, bamii ba duude bo gɛ̀ yu wa n'yɛyɛ wu Bita bɛ Joŋ, bo gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ, ŋgoo yiboo duu, bilɛŋsɛ mo bo nyume wa njɛ banchvuge batɛŋ (5,000).
Bvu gɛ̀ bu bvuyuu, bachiji woŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ mo bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo, taashɛ kijusɛ ki mumwaa Yɛlusalɛm.
Anas wù kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ bɛ Kayfa mo Joŋ bɛ Alɛksanda mo bamii bamu ba gɛ̀ bee tɛ kfuu chi kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ nyu fo.
Bo mo bo leesɛ Bita bɛ Joŋ a bo jii, bo biih bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ chi jo faaŋ bvuŋga fɛ bɛŋ fɛ muh wunɛ? Bɛŋ chi fɛ a jee chi yɛɛŋ le?”
Kiyo ki Yuude yisɛ yi Bita le, ki ge wu chvuu bo le lɛ, “Chiji woŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ,
bee lɛme fɛnɛ abɛŋ ki bee tanyɛ jwe kune lɛme chì joŋe chì bee chi ge fɛ kiŋkɛlɛ kinɛ le, fɛ wu jîɛnyi. No bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ kɛ̂ɛ no fi chi jiɛnyɛ,

bɛŋ mo bamii bachii ba Ishwala kêe lɛ muh wunɛ lɛme a bɛŋ jii mɛɛse wù nyu wu tɛmɛ nɛ, nje jee chi Jiso Kletu wu Nasalɛ. Jiso wunɛ le wù bɛŋ gɛ̀ jo bɛŋ ta yi kintaaŋ le wu kwe, geenɛ Nyo kaasɛ wu bvusɛ wu yi kwe le.
Wu le tɛdɛ chi Ŋwa wu Nyo jɛmɛ kune chi lɛ,

content.text: ‘Tɛdɛ chì bamii ba njonɛ gɛ̀ faŋ
lé chi jâ chi tû tɛdɛ chi buu chi yeh.’

content: Le gɛh Jiso maa wù bvuuse bamii. Gɛ jee chi muh mu ka nyume yu fɛkuu fɛnɛ chi Nyo le wu gɛɛ lɛ taŋlo chi bvuuse bamii gɛ.”
Bamii ba gɛ̀ sage baa, yu no Bita bɛ Joŋ jɛme bo ya faane gɛ, bo ka bo yɛŋ lɛ le bamii ba nchɛ, bo kee gɛ ŋwa chuule gɛ, de yuŋ lo bo. Bo mo bo kɛɛ lɛ fi le noo, nje le bamii ba gɛ̀ jiɛnyi bɛ Jiso.
Bo gɛ ka bo kɛme fiɛɛ fì bo tɛɛnyi Bita bɛ Joŋ yi fi le gɛ, nje bo gɛ̀ yɛde muh wù ba gɛ̀ fɛ le, wu lɛme bɛ bo.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ sage bayu ja bo bvusɛ bo akfuuŋ, bo mo bo shɛɛ bo tu bo chude bantaŋ lɛbolɛbo bo duu lɛ,
“Bee lé be gê nɛɛ bɛ bamii banɛ? Bamii bachii ba Yɛlusalɛm le bo kɛɛ wa kune fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo bwanyi le finɛ fi bo ge, gɛ taŋlo bee faŋ gɛ.
Geenɛ, ki bee ge lɛ keefɛ saaka wuyu wunɛ ka wu sâaŋe wu gɛ̂ɛne fwe gɛ, bee kâjɛ bamii banɛ lɛ keefɛ bo ka bo môŋ lo bo jɛ̂mɛ fiɛɛ muh le kune jee chi Jiso wunɛ gɛ.”
Bo tɛɛŋ Bita bɛ Joŋ bo kaasɛ bo lee. Bo lejɛ lo bo le lɛ keefɛ bo ka bo môŋ lo bo jɛme, kɛnɛ bo yɛyi muh kune jee chi Jiso gɛ.
Bita bɛ Joŋ chvuu fiboo lɛ, “Bɛŋ kwâjɛ laa fiɛɛ fì le chuule fɛ Nyo le, le lɛ bee yû nyu bɛŋ le noo, wu wù Nyo le la?
Gɛ taŋlo bee lu ki be jɛ̂me kune mwɛɛ mù bee le be yɛŋ bee ka be yu gɛ.”
Bamii ba gɛ̀ sage bayu bo ka bo lejɛ lo fi tɛmɛ, bo mo bo chinɛ bo le bo ja bo gɛɛne. Bo gɛ̀ fu fiɛɛ fì bo leesɛ bo yi ŋgɛ le, nje bamii bachii gɛ̀ yuuse Nyo yi fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ le,
fi ka fi ge muh wuyu wù ba gɛ̀ ge fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo finɛ ki ba fɛ wu wù tɛmɛ gɛ̀ bee wu fede wa biluŋ mbaanyɛ.
Bamii ba mbɛmɛ lɛgɛ bvuŋga a Nyo le
No bo chinɛ Bita bɛ Joŋ le noo, bo kaasɛ bo tu jiŋ fɛ bamii baboo ba ŋgoo le, bo sɛɛŋ bo fiɛɛ fì bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ be jɛmɛ.
Bo yu, bo mo bo banyɛ ye bo lɛgɛ Nyo yi muh le wu mumwaa lɛ, “Tada, Chiji Kikwɛɛ wù gɛ̀ fɛ kibvulɛ bɛ nshɛŋ bɛ jóo mo mwɛɛ munchii mù le manjuu manɛ le.
Wo wù gɛ̀ ge chiji bachiji besa wù Dabi wù gɛ̀ bee mwa yo wu lɛme, wu jɛmɛ bɛ bvuŋga bvu Kiyo ki Yuude le lɛ,

content.text: ‘Le nje la wù bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ fuge bɛ fiɛɛ shɛ́ŋ le,
bamii chude bantaŋ njɛ bo lé bo lɛ̂ɛŋ sɛŋ?
Banfoŋ ba fɛkuu fɛnɛ seese jɛŋ,
ki bo juu bɛ Tada bɛ muh we wù wu le wu yefɛ lɛ le Mbvusɛ.’

content: Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ bɛ fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ alaantɛŋ yanɛ. Nfoŋ Hɛlod bɛ Bontu Balɛt gɛ̀ taashɛ bɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ mo bamii ba Ishwala bo ji nchvuuŋ yi Jiso wu le mwa yo wu lɛme wù yuude wù wo gɛ̀ yefɛ lɛ wu le Mbvusɛ.
Bo gɛ̀ taashɛ ki bo ge nyu mwɛɛ mù wo gɛ̀ bee wo seesɛ wa je yì ndefe le bɛ bvuŋga bwuŋ no wo koŋe lɛ mu gê mu kôoshɛ.
Noo, yi mɛɛse le Tada, bîjɛ wo yɛ̂ŋ je yì bamii banɛ nyuse bɛ bee. Nya bee bamii buŋ ba lɛme bɛ muntele mù tɛɛme ki bee feeji jɛ yo bee faane gɛ.
Nya bee bɛ bvuŋga bwuŋ bee fɛde bamii bee ka gee mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bwuŋ bɛ mwɛɛ mu de yì yunɛ a jee chi Jiso wù Mwa yo wu lɛme wù yuude le.”
No bo mɛse bo buunɛ, nshɛŋ shiŋshɛ fɛ bo gɛ̀ bee fo. Kiyo ki Yuude yisɛ yi bo le, bo mo bo tu bo feeji jɛ yi Nyo bo faane gɛ.
Ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ kɛme fiɛɛ fiboo fimimia
Ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ gɛ̀ bee fitele fimimia, bo nyu yi muh le wu mumwaa, muh tɛŋe gɛ fiɛɛ fimi lɛ le fie wumaa gɛ. Fiɛɛ fi muh gɛ̀ bee fi bamii bachii.
Nyo nya bvuŋga bvù baaŋ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso le, bo tu bo feeji bamii le fi tɛɛme lo lɛ Tada Jiso gɛ̀ bu yi kwe le. Nfii wu Nyo nyume yi bo le bachii wesee.
Gɛ muh gɛ̀ nyu yu wu fuude a bo ntɛnɛɛ gɛ, nje bamii ba gɛ̀ kɛme ŋɛɛ kɛnɛ yéh, bo gɛ̀ gese bo too bɛ bige biyu,
bo nyaa chiaaŋ yi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso le, bo mo bo gade bamii le bachii no ŋgɛ wu muh gɛ̀ bee.
Muh mu gɛ̀ bee ba tɛŋe lɛ Yosɛf, booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso chu jee che chimi lɛ Banaba, (Chì le lɛ, Muh N'yufɛ Muntele). Wu gɛ̀ bee muh wu a kfuu chi Lɛwe le, ba gɛ̀ boyi wu Sablu.
Wu mo wu gɛɛŋ tɛ wu gesɛ we mwɛ, wu to wu nya bige biyu chiaaŋ yi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso le.
